**Keith Alan Hippely** is a former Mattel employee who worked with Hot Wheels as a staff designer from 1980 to 2013. He is most noted for having worked on the [Attack Pack](/wiki/Attack_Pack) and [Road Beasts](/wiki/Road_Beasts) lines of monster trucks and having developed the [Super Slammers](/wiki/Super_Slammers) and [Color Racers](/wiki/Color_Racers) line in the 1980s. He currently works at InvenToy, a company started by him and fellow ex-Hot Wheels engineer [Eric Ostendorff](/wiki/Eric_Ostendorff).
